_comment: Identity pack VERSION folder per character under specs/image-generator-tests/refs/<character>/<version>/. This is the SINGLE pointer every identity proof runner resolves its reference images from. To switch a character to a different approved pack for the next test run, change ONLY the version value here (e.g. "v7" -> "v8") - no runner code changes needed. Previous: dean v8 photo-crop refs with clothing visible (replaced 2026-09-10), becky v5 chin-cut crops, dean v7 (clothing bled into every identity edit).
